UI_trait_BloodThirst_desc: You must feed on the dead to survive.
UI_trait_SunTolerant_desc: Can move under the sun, but blood thirst drains faster.
UI_trait_NightHunter_desc: Absolute predator of the night; by day, a weaker shadow.
UI_trait_NightThirst_desc: The night awakens a stronger thirst, but feeding restores more.
UI_trait_DayTorpor_desc: During the day you fall into lethargy: slower and weaker, but thirst eases while resting.
UI_trait_SombrasEternas_desc: Thrives in darkness: stronger at night, but weakened under the sun.
UI_trait_CondenaSolar_desc: Endures daylight better, but thirst rises faster at night.
UI_trait_LordVampire_desc: A vampire who awakens true power: blood-fed combat bonuses, night vigor, and dark regeneration.
UI_profession_vampire_desc: Creature of the night. Thirsts for blood; vulnerable to sunlight.
